sentences.en: Virtually every child, the world over, plays.
sentences.zh: 放眼全世界，几乎每个孩子都玩游戏。

sentences.en: The drive to play is so intense that children will do so in any circumstances, for instance when they have no real toys, or when parents do not actively encourage the behavior.
sentences.zh: 孩子想玩的冲动如此强烈，什么情况下都能玩起来，例如手边没有真正的玩具，或父母没有主动鼓励他们玩的时候。

sentences.en: In the eyes of a young child, running, pretending, and building are fun.
sentences.zh: 在幼儿眼里，奔跑、玩扮演游戏、动手搭东西都是乐趣。

sentences.en: Researchers and educators know that these playful activities benefit the development of the whole child across social, cognitive, physical, and emotional domains.
sentences.zh: 研究者和教育工作者知道，这些游戏活动有益于儿童在社交、认知、身体和情绪等方面的全面发展。

sentences.en: Indeed, play is such an instrumental component to healthy child development that the United Nations High Commission on Human Rights (1989) recognized play as a fundamental right of every child.
sentences.zh: 事实上，游戏对儿童的健康发展起着如此重要的作用，以至于联合国人权委员会在1989年将游戏认定为每名儿童的一项基本权利。

sentences.en: Yet, while experts continue to expound a powerful argument for the importance of play in children’s lives, the actual time children spend playing continues to decrease.
sentences.zh: 然而，尽管专家们不断有力地论述游戏对于儿童生活的重要性，孩子们实际用来玩耍的时间却仍在减少。

sentences.en: Today, children play eight hours less each week than their counterparts did two decades ago (Elkind 2008).
sentences.zh: 现在的儿童每周玩耍的时间比20年前的同龄人少八小时（Elkind，2008）。

sentences.en: Under pressure of rising academic standards, play is being replaced by test preparation in kindergartens and grade schools, and parents who aim to give their preschoolers a leg up are led to believe that flashcards and educational ‘toys’ are the path to success.
sentences.zh: 在学业标准不断提高的压力下，幼儿园和小学里的游戏时间正让位于备考。那些想让学龄前孩子取得优势的家长，也被引导着相信，识字卡和益智“玩具”才是通往成功的途径。

sentences.en: Our society has created a false dichotomy between play and learning.
sentences.zh: 我们的社会把游戏和学习看成了一对非此即彼的选项，这种对立是虚假的。

sentences.en: Through play, children learn to regulate their behavior, lay the foundations for later learning in science and mathematics, figure out the complex negotiations of social relationships, build a repertoire of creative problem-solving skills, and so much more.
sentences.zh: 在游戏中，孩子们学会调节自己的行为，为日后学习科学和数学打下基础，摸索与人交往时复杂的协商过程，并积累一整套创造性解决问题的技能，收获还远不止于此。

sentences.en: There is also an important role for adults in guiding children through playful learning opportunities.
sentences.zh: 在引导儿童通过游戏学习时，成人也起着重要作用。

sentences.en: Full consensus on a formal definition of play continues to elude the researchers and theorists who study it.
sentences.zh: 对于究竟怎样给游戏下一个正式定义，研究这一问题的学者和理论家至今未能达成完全一致。

sentences.en: Definitions range from discrete descriptions of various types of play such as physical, construction, language, or symbolic play (Miller & Almon 2009), to lists of broad criteria, based on observations and attitudes, that are meant to capture the essence of all play behaviors (e.g. Rubin et al. 1983).
sentences.zh: 有的定义分别描述各种游戏，例如身体活动游戏、建构游戏、语言游戏和象征性游戏（Miller与Almon，2009）。也有定义依据观察和态度列出通用标准，试图把握一切游戏行为的本质（例如Rubin等，1983）。

sentences.en: A majority of the contemporary definitions of play focus on several key criteria.
sentences.zh: 当代关于游戏的定义，大多数都注重几个关键标准。

sentences.en: The founder of the National Institute for Play, Stuart Brown, has described play as ‘anything that spontaneously is done for its own sake’.
sentences.zh: 美国国家游戏研究所的创办人斯图尔特·布朗曾这样描述游戏：“凡是自发去做、只是为了活动本身而做的事。”

sentences.en: More specifically, he says it ‘appears purposeless, produces pleasure and joy, [and] leads one to the next stage of mastery’ (as quoted in Tippett 2008).
sentences.zh: 他进一步说，游戏“看似没有目的，却能带来快乐和喜悦，[并]引领人进入掌握技能的下一阶段”（转引自Tippett，2008）。

sentences.en: Similarly, Miller and Almon (2009) say that play includes ‘activities that are freely chosen and directed by children and arise from intrinsic motivation’.
sentences.zh: 同样，Miller和Almon（2009）认为，游戏包括“儿童自由选择和主导、源自内在动机的活动”。

sentences.en: Often, play is defined along a continuum as more or less playful using the following set of behavioral and dispositional criteria (e.g. Rubin et al. 1983): Play is pleasurable: Children must enjoy the activity or it is not play.
sentences.zh: 研究者往往依据下面这组行为和个体倾向方面的标准，把游戏放在一个连续谱上，考察一项活动或多或少有怎样的游戏性（例如Rubin等，1983）。游戏令人愉快：孩子必须享受这种活动，否则就称不上游戏。

sentences.en: It is intrinsically motivated: Children engage in play simply for the satisfaction the behavior itself brings.
sentences.zh: 游戏受内在动机驱使：儿童参与游戏，纯粹是为了获得这一行为本身带来的满足。

sentences.en: It has no extrinsically motivated function or goal.
sentences.zh: 它不具有由外在动机决定的功能或目标。

sentences.en: Play is process oriented: When children play, the means are more important than the ends.
sentences.zh: 游戏注重过程：孩子玩耍时，怎么玩比最后要达成什么目的更重要。

sentences.en: It is freely chosen, spontaneous and voluntary.
sentences.zh: 游戏由自己自由选择，是自发、自愿的。

sentences.en: If a child is pressured, they will likely not think of the activity as play.
sentences.zh: 如果孩子受到强迫，那他很可能不会把这项活动看成游戏。

sentences.en: Play is actively engaged: Players must be physically and/or mentally involved in the activity.
sentences.zh: 游戏需要主动投入：玩的人必须在身体上、心理上或同时在两方面参与其中。

sentences.en: Play is non-literal.
sentences.zh: 游戏里的行为不能全按字面来理解。

sentences.en: It involves make-believe.
sentences.zh: 它包含想象和假装。

sentences.en: According to this view, children’s playful behaviors can range in degree from 0% to 100% playful.
sentences.zh: 按照这种看法，儿童行为的游戏性可以从0%到100%不等。

sentences.en: Rubin and colleagues did not assign greater weight to any one dimension in determining playfulness; however, other researchers have suggested that process orientation and a lack of obvious functional purpose may be the most important aspects of play (e.g. Pellegrini 2009).
sentences.zh: 在判断游戏性时，Rubin和同事没有给任何一个维度更大的权重。不过，其他研究者认为，重过程以及没有明显的实际功用，可能是游戏最重要的两方面（例如Pellegrini，2009）。

sentences.en: From the perspective of a continuum, play can thus blend with other motives and attitudes that are less playful, such as work.
sentences.zh: 因此，从连续谱的角度看，游戏可以与游戏性较低的动机和态度融合，例如与工作有关的动机和态度。

sentences.en: Unlike play, work is typically not viewed as enjoyable and it is extrinsically motivated (i.e. it is goal oriented).
sentences.zh: 工作则不同，人们通常不会觉得它有趣，而且它受外在动机驱使，换言之，它以目标为导向。

sentences.en: Researcher Joan Goodman (1994) suggested that hybrid forms of work and play are not a detriment to learning; rather, they can provide optimal contexts for learning.
sentences.zh: 研究者琼·古德曼（1994）认为，工作与游戏的结合不会妨碍学习，反而可能提供最有利于学习的情境。

sentences.en: For example, a child may be engaged in a difficult, goal-directed activity set up by their teacher, but they may still be actively engaged and intrinsically motivated.
sentences.zh: 例如，孩子可能在做老师安排的一项难度较高、目标明确的活动，但依然可以主动投入，而且出于内在意愿参与。

sentences.en: At this mid-point between play and work, the child’s motivation, coupled with guidance from an adult, can create robust opportunities for playful learning.
sentences.zh: 在游戏与工作之间的这个中间地带，孩子自身的动机与成人的引导结合起来，可以创造出充分而有效的游戏学习机会。

sentences.en: Critically, recent research supports the idea that adults can facilitate children’s learning while maintaining a playful approach in interactions known as ‘guided play’ (Fisher et al. 2011).
sentences.zh: 重要的是，近期研究支持这样一种观点：在称为“引导式游戏”的互动中，成人可以一边保持游戏的方式，一边促进儿童学习（Fisher等，2011）。

sentences.en: The adult’s role in play varies as a function of their educational goals and the child’s developmental level (Hirsch-Pasek et al. 2009).
sentences.zh: 成人在游戏中扮演什么角色，取决于其教育目标和儿童的发展水平（Hirsch-Pasek等，2009）。

sentences.en: Guided play takes two forms.
sentences.zh: 引导式游戏有两种形式。

sentences.en: At a very basic level, adults can enrich the child’s environment by providing objects or experiences that promote aspects of a curriculum.
sentences.zh: 最基本的做法是，由成人提供有助于实现部分课程目标的物品或体验，来丰富儿童所处的环境。

sentences.en: In the more direct form of guided play, parents or other adults can support children’s play by joining in the fun as a co-player, raising thoughtful questions, commenting on children’s discoveries, or encouraging further exploration or new facets to the child’s activity.
sentences.zh: 在更为直接的引导式游戏中，父母或其他成人可以作为游戏伙伴，一起参与其中，为孩子提供支持。他们可以提出引发思考的问题，就孩子的发现加以评论，也可以鼓励孩子继续探索，或给活动增加新的内容。

sentences.en: Although playful learning can be somewhat structured, it must also be child-centered (Nicolopolou et al. 2006).
sentences.zh: 游戏式学习可以有一定安排，但也必须以儿童为中心（Nicolopolou等，2006）。

sentences.en: Play should stem from the child’s own desire.
sentences.zh: 游戏应当源自儿童自己的意愿。

sentences.en: Both free and guided play are essential elements in a child-centered approach to playful learning.
sentences.zh: 在以儿童为中心的游戏学习方式中，自由游戏和引导式游戏都是不可缺少的组成部分。

sentences.en: Intrinsically motivated free play provides the child with true autonomy, while guided play is an avenue through which parents and educators can provide more targeted learning experiences.
sentences.zh: 出于内在动机的自由游戏能让孩子获得真正的自主权，引导式游戏则给家长和教育工作者提供了一条途径，可以让孩子获得更有针对性的学习体验。

sentences.en: In either case, play should be actively engaged, it should be predominantly child-directed, and it must be fun.
sentences.zh: 无论是哪一种，孩子都应该主动投入，游戏应主要由孩子主导，而且必须有趣。
